covered_report_window: Monday, October 26, 2026 after the U.S. market close through Tuesday, October 27, 2026 before the U.S. market open.
market_context_summary: The FOMC meeting begins Tuesday, with a Wednesday decision expected to hold rates steady after a September hike; stubborn inflation, high oil prices and weakening consumer confidence raise the hurdle for cyclicals and premium valuations. Tuesday also brings durable-goods and consumer-confidence data.

methodology.disparity_definition: Average absolute deviation of the three direction scores and three reversal-risk scores, scaled to a 0-100 caution measure; lower means tighter agreement.
methodology.lessons_review: Existing expectation-bar, key-metric and forward-look guardrails were applied narrowly; no new method change was added from this run.
